chunks: There is no issue in placing the deceased between your legs and standing over him to wash him. When you turn him to the right or left, hold him firmly with your legs so that he does not fall on his face.

key_terms.الْمَيِّتَ: the deceased person being prepared and washed
key_terms.تَضْبِطُهُ: to hold or steady him firmly
key_terms.شِمالًا: toward the left side while turning the body
key_terms.فَتُغَسِّلَهُ: to wash him as part of the funeral rites
key_terms.يَمِينًا: toward the right side while turning the body

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to hold the deceased with one's legs while washing the body?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a practical legal ruling regarding the ghusl of the deceased. It permits positioning the body between one's legs and stabilizing it while turning it during washing, in order to prevent it from falling forward.
